fee_notes: Standard first-franchise fee $49,000; additional franchise or Center Director discount $26,500; transferee fee $7,000 (may be waived); veteran/educator discount 25% off first-center fee; development fee $75,500-$129,000 for 2-5 centers credited toward franchise fees. In 2025, fees paid ranged $0-$49,000.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee is $49,000 for your first franchise. You must pay the entire fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement. In 2025, the range of initial franchise fees paid to us or our predecessor, MCL, was $0 to $49,000.
